name: Neighborhood Composition & Mixing
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: How mixed each cell's neighbourhood is, and who sits next to whom.
citation: Shannon (1948) Bell Syst. Tech. J. 27:379-423; Pielou (1966) J. Theor. Biol. 13:131-144.

params.name: k
params.label: Neighbours (k)
params.help:
Sets how many nearest cells define each neighbourhood.
Larger values measure mixing over a broader area and produce a smoother result.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help:
Selects the annotation used to define the groups.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: min_type_cells
params.label: Minimum cells per category
params.help: Categories with fewer cells are not shown in the matrix or table, but are still included in each cell’s mixing score.
